caption: Isola Tiberina, Rome
composition: Boat-shaped Tiber Island between Ponte Fabricio and Ponte Cestio · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the riverbank the camera faces the boat-shaped Isola Tiberina centered in the Tiber, its stone prow pointing toward the viewer. Ponte Fabricio's arches cross on the left and Ponte Cestio's on the right, and the church with its bell tower rises among the cypresses on the island. The 11:37 midday light is clear, the water calm and green with reflections.
